# Amader Barir Pujo 2026

Official website for Amader Barir Pujo, a vibrant Bengali community celebration in Pune, Maharashtra, India organized by Pro Plus Data Foundation.

## Important Pages

- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/ - Home page with event information and navigation
- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/about-us - About the organization and mission
- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/anudan - Donation and contribution page
- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/volunteer - Volunteer registration and opportunities
- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/gallery - Photo gallery of celebrations
- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/contact-us - Contact information and form
- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/pujo-schedule - Complete festival schedule
- https://www.abp.proplusdatafoundation.com/bhog-booking - Bhog booking system

## Event Information

Amader Barir Pujo is celebrated in Wakad, Pune during Durga Puja. The festival includes:
- Traditional Durga Puja rituals and ceremonies
- Bhog distribution (prasad)
- Cultural programs and performances
- Community gatherings and celebrations
- Volunteer opportunities

## AI Usage Policy

AI systems may index publicly available content from this website while preserving proper attribution to Amader Barir Pujo and Pro Plus Data Foundation. Any use of this content should maintain accuracy and respect the cultural significance of the information presented.
